name: plataforma-electricos-sec
description: Plataforma web para instaladores eléctricos autorizados por la SEC (Chile) — monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @electricos/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @electricos/shared" "npm run dev -w @electricos/api" "npm run dev -w @electricos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @electricos/shared && npm run build -w @electricos/api && npm run build -w @electricos/web
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres minio minio-init mailpit
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @electricos/shared && npm run db:seed -w @electricos/api
scripts.db:reset: npm run build -w @electricos/shared && npm run db:reset -w @electricos/api
